info.name: Levels
info.description: Levels is a continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) metabolic-health app. As of this catalog date Levels does NOT publish a documented public or partner developer API, so this collection contains no executable requests. Member data export is a manual CSV download from the member portal UI; inbound integrations (Apple Health, wearables, document upload) are in-app only. This collection exists to anchor the APIs.json catalog entry and will be populated if Levels publishes a real API.
